what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted by roll call to have staff get at least two engineering quotes on a possible Upland Ave and Eastern Ave sewer extension, with White Street added.
Staff will solicit the quotes rather than the commission choosing a firm, and the commission will reconvene when they are in, in about two weeks.
Fitchburg's comments on the sewer regulation changes will go to town counsel first, then back to the commission before anything is sent on.
The year-to-date sewer budget was described as on target, with expenses ahead of revenues because yearly transfers to the town come early.
Three invoices were reviewed, Fitchburg's monthly and debt service bills and an engineering bill, and the chair will initial them, noting verbal approval at the Zoom meeting.

why_it_matters: Quotes on preliminary engineering cost come before residents on the proposed extension streets are surveyed, so they are likely to see a cost estimate before being asked whether they want sewer service.
The regulation changes Fitchburg commented on govern the shared sewer system, and their final form could affect what users are required to do and pay.
watch_next: The commission's next meeting, about two weeks out, when the engineering quotes are due back.
Town counsel's review of Fitchburg's comments on the sewer regulations, before the commission sees them again.
